name: tpl-existence-two-3-goal
task: Be holding the key on at least two different moves, open the door and reach the goal.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: Existence(door_open) is redundant. ExistenceTwo(has_key) and the environment constraint that “door_open cannot become true before has_key” already require the key, while Existence(at_goal) with Precedence(door_open, at_goal) requires the door to open. Remove Existence(door_open); keep the other clauses.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: ExistenceTwo(has_key) requires carrying the key on two different moves, and Existence(at_goal) with Precedence(door_open, at_goal) requires reaching the goal only after opening the door.

texts: The agent must be carrying the key on at least two different moves.
The door must be opened before reaching the goal.
